book.name: Galɛshiaŋ
book.title: Ŋwa wù Bol gɛ̀ saŋ fɛ kintaashɛ ki Galɛshiaŋ le

content: Fiɛɛ fì nduu le lɛ, muh nɛ le ki wu jî bvushɛ bvu chiji, geenɛ wu baaŋ mwa wù shige, tu gɛ yeye nyu yu bɛ nfwa wu chiji gɛ, mo nyu wu wù kɛme bvushɛ bvuyu bvuchii.
Wu lé wu ya wu nyûme bamii bamu jîiŋe fɛ wu le, bvushɛ bvuyu nyu chiaaŋ yi bamii bamu le bo jiiŋe fo, gɛ̂ɛŋ bû kife kì chiji seese le.
Le gɛh no fi le fɛ besabɛŋ le. Gɛ̀ bee sege besabɛŋ gɛ̀ bee njɛ booŋ ba shige, bee nyu nfa yi mwɛɛ mù sage yi woŋ kfunɛ le.
Sege kife kì chuule gɛ̀ to ki kojɛ, Nyo tuŋ Mwa ye wu to, kwɛse boo wu, wu tu wu nyu tɛ a banchi kuu.
Wu gɛ̀ to wu lɛ wu sûuŋ bamii ba le a banchi kuu, Nyo mo wu jô besabɛŋ njɛ booŋ be.
No Nyo jo wa besabɛŋ njɛ booŋ be noo, wu mo wu chiiŋsɛ Kiyo ki Mwa ye lɛ ki tô a muntele mwesa besabɛŋ le. Le ki kì tɛŋe wu lɛ, “Aba,
Chii.”
Fi le lɛ Nyo le wu ge wa lɛ bɛŋ baaŋ gɛ nfa gɛ. Bɛŋ le wa booŋ ba yeh. No bɛŋ le wa booŋ, tu fi le lɛ bɛŋ lé bɛŋ kɛ̂mɛ mwɛɛ mù wu gɛle fɛ booŋ be le.
Bol faane lɛ bamii ba Galɛshiaŋ le bo jiaa wa je
Gɛ̀ bee fweele sege bɛŋ gɛ̀ baaŋ a kɛɛ gɛ Nyo gɛ, bɛŋ lɛne bvunfa chiaaŋ yi mwɛɛ mù bɛŋ gɛ̀ jode lɛ le banyo nyume gɛ banyo gɛ.

Geenɛ, mɛɛse no bɛŋ le bɛŋ kɛɛ wa Nyo, kɛnɛ lɛ mɛɛse no Nyo le wu kɛɛ wa bɛŋ no mbee ki njɛ̂mɛ, bɛŋ jiɛnyi nɛɛ fɛ bɛŋ gôone ki bɛŋ tûu jiŋ fɛ banyo ba achiji banɛ le, ba le njɛ bo kɛme bvuŋga sɛŋ. Bɛŋ goone ki bɛŋ ka bɛŋ tûu nfa yi banyo bayu banɛ le, nje la?
Bɛŋ gɛɛde yuuŋ aju a mu le, a mu nyume a baaŋ baaŋ, bɛŋ banɛ kii yimi, bɛŋ banɛ bife bimi yi kiluŋ le, bɛŋ banɛ biluŋ nje la?
Bɛŋ gee nɛ nfaane baaŋ lɛ lɛme chì nlɛŋ a bɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ le chi lɛ̂sɛ achiji.
Booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ, ŋkude lo chiaaŋ bɛŋ le lɛ bɛŋ kûsɛ bɛŋ nyû njɛ mɛ, gɛh no ŋgɛ̀ ŋkusɛ mɛ nyume njɛ bɛŋ, sege bɛŋ gɛ̀ baaŋ a kɛmɛ gɛ banchi gɛ. Bɛŋ gɛ̀ baaŋ ge gɛ fiɛɛ fì befe fɛ mɛne gɛ.
Bɛŋ kee lɛ fweele sege ŋgɛ̀ nfeeji saaka wù joŋe wu Nyo bɛŋ le gɛ̀ bee nje ŋgɛ̀ nchɛne lo.

Mo no ŋgɛ̀ bee yi kinchɛŋ le nɛ, ki gɛ̀ bee njɛ mmoŋ wu gɛ̀ to fɛ bɛŋ le, bɛŋ gɛ̀ baaŋ legɛ gɛ, kɛnɛ bɛŋ nyiɛŋsɛ mɛ gɛ. Bɛŋ ka jode lo mɛ ye yene le njɛ nchɛndaa wu Nyo wumu kɛnɛ njɛ Kletu Jiso kibɛɛ.
Bɛŋ gɛ̀ yuge njoŋ bɛ mɛ sege kɛɛ, kooshi la mɛɛse? Taŋlo njɛ̂mɛ lɛ nɛ je gɛ̀ bee yu ki bɛŋ bâayɛ ajii a wene bɛŋ nyâ mɛne, tu bɛŋ gɛ̀ baayɛ gɛh lo.
Nle ntu wa muh wu kimbanɛ fɛ bɛŋ le no nsɛŋe nchiɛɛŋ bɛŋ le?
Bamii baa goone ki bo dûunyi lɛ bo kɛme kiŋkoŋɛ fɛ bɛŋ le baaŋ, geenɛ bo goone bɛŋ yi fiɛɛ le nyû gɛ fì joŋe gɛ. Bo koŋe lɛ besabɛŋ gâsɛ lɛ bɛŋ kɛ̂me kiŋkoŋɛ nyu fɛ bo le.
Fi joŋe lɛ muh kɛ̂me kiŋkoŋɛ fɛ muh le yi fiɛɛ fì joŋe le. Finɛ le chuule segechii, nyu gɛ lɛ sege nle besabɛŋ maa gɛ.
Booŋ baŋ ba le shɛ́ŋ yaŋ, nle gɛh njɛ mbaaŋ ŋka ŋkɛ lo lume chena, n'yɛŋ ŋgɛ ŋgɛ̂ɛŋ mbû no kinche ki Kletu le ki nyû ye yene le!
Muh jô lɛ mbe mbee besabɛŋ mɛɛse, wu lɛ ŋkûsɛ je yì njɛme yu bɛŋ le. Fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ ge finɛ le bvufee lɛsɛ lo mɛ.
Yeye yeye wu booŋ ba Ablaham
Bɛŋ ba goone ki bɛŋ nyû a banchi kuu, bɛŋ sɛ̂ɛŋ la mɛ, bɛŋ yuge gɛh fiɛɛ fì banchi jɛme?
Ba le ba saŋ lɛ Ablaham gɛ̀ kɛme booŋ ba bilɛŋsɛ bafɛɛ, wu gɛ̀ boo wumu bɛ kwɛse wù le nfwa, wu boo wumu bɛ kwɛse wù le gɛ nfwa gɛ.
Nfwa wunɛ gɛ̀ boo mwa gɛh no ba to ba boyi booŋ bachii. Geenɛ kwɛse wù le gɛ nfwa gɛ wɛɛ gɛ̀ boo we mwa wu bii ŋka wù Nyo gɛ̀ fɛ le.

Taŋlo besabɛŋ jo fiɛɛ finɛ njɛ mbejɛ wu fiɛɛ. Bikɛse ba bafɛɛ banɛ duunyi maŋkaŋ mà manfɛɛ. Aga wù gɛ̀ bee nfwa jode kijusɛ ki maŋkaŋ mà Nyo gɛ̀ gwo bɛ bamii ba Ishwala yi Mbegɛ wu Sina le. Bamii bachii ba le akuu a maŋkaŋ mayu le nfa.

No Aga jode kijusɛ ki maŋkaŋ ma yi Mbegɛ wu Sina wù le woŋ wù Alɛbia le, wu ka wu jode tɛ kijusɛ ki kilaantɛŋ kì Yɛlusalɛm wù mɛɛse le, nje bamii ba a kilaantɛŋ kiyu le bachii le nfa a banchi kuu.
Geenɛ bamii ba Yɛlusalɛm wù fɛwe le gɛ nyu nfa gɛ. Wuwɛɛ Yɛlusalɛm le bwee wese besabɛŋ.
Le fiɛɛ fì ba gɛ̀ saŋ lɛ,

content.text: “Wo wù kwɛse wù le kaa wu boyi gɛ, wo lâŋeye.
Wo wù gɛ̀ baaŋ a luŋ gɛ wa mwa gɛ, wo kwâase chike.
Wo kêe lɛ booŋ ba kwɛse wù ba le ba baa jiŋ wu le,
bo lé bo dûude bo fêde ba kwɛse wù le bɛ jwɛŋsɛ.”

content: Noo, booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ, bɛŋ le booŋ ba Nyo bii no Nyo gɛ̀ ka yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no Ablaham gɛ̀ boyɛ Asik bii no Nyo gɛ̀ ka.
Gɛ̀ bee kife kiyu le, mwa wù ba gɛ̀ boyɛ no ba boyi booŋ bachii, tu wu boone bikaa ajiŋ a mwa wù gɛ̀ nya Kiyo ki Nyo bvuŋga fɛ ba boo wu. Le gɛh tɛ yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ bɛ fiɛɛ fì kooshi mɛɛse.
Ba le ba saŋ a Ŋwa wu Nyo le kune fiɛɛ finɛ lɛ la? Ba le ba saŋ lɛ,

content.text: “Kûŋɛ bɛ kwɛse wù le nfwa bɛ mwa ye bachii,
nje gɛ mwa nfwa taŋlo wu gâ bvushɛ bɛ mwa kwɛse wù le gɛ nfwa gɛ.”

content: No fi le noo booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ, fiɛɛ fì njɛme fichii duunyi lɛ gɛ besabɛŋ nyu booŋ ba kwɛse wù le nfwa gɛ. Besabɛŋ le nyu booŋ ba kwɛse wù le gɛ nfwa gɛ.

footnotes.text: Mwɛɛ mù sage yi woŋ kfunɛ le taŋlo nyu banchi mo biyo.
Aba le a jɛ́ yi Alamaik le lɛ Chii.
